title: Your first trade for Thursday, January 31
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of the Mexico ETF .
Steve Grasso was a buyer of General Electric .
Dan Nathan was a buyer of PayPal .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Sarepta Therapeutics .
